meta.name: five-zone-tribute-system
meta.description: Use when managing tribute obligations or enforcing compliance across distance-based zones. Structures five concentric zones (五服制度) from daily offerings to lifetime homage, with escalation protocols for non-compliance.

copy.tagline: 管理基于距离的进贡与合规义务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要管理多层级进贡制度与违规升级流程。
copy.tagline_en: Manage tribute obligations and compliance across distance-based zones.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage multi-tier tribute systems and escalation protocols.

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 会按照五服制度（五个同心距离区）来管理贡赋义务：为每个区域分配不同的贡赋频率（从每日到终生），并当义务未履行时，依次建议从教化到惩罚的升级措施。
howto.when: 当用户需要管理基于距离的多区域贡赋义务，或处理某个区域不履行贡赋的情况时触发。

say.text: 帮我评估一下甸服区域的贡赋履行情况。
say.note: Claude 会检查甸服（最近区域）的日祭义务是否完成。

say.text: 荒服区域不朝贡，该怎么处理？

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude will manage tribute obligations according to the five-zone system: assign different tribute frequencies (daily to lifetime) based on distance, and propose escalation from cultivation to punishment when obligations are not met.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users need to manage multi-zone tribute obligations based on distance, or handle non-compliance in a specific zone.

say_en.text: Evaluate the tribute status of the Royal Domain.
say_en.note: Claude will check if daily offerings from the closest zone are satisfied.

say_en.text: The Wild Zone is not paying homage, what to do?
